writer.name: 克里斯蒂娜·戈洛佐娃 Kristina Grozeva
佩塔尔·瓦查诺夫 Petar Valchanov

introduction: Kamen is the man everyone looks to when something needs to be done. His one flaw is his insurmountable desire to be wealthy and successful at any cost. However, two things happen that he hasn't anticipated. First, he falls in love with an ordinary girl whose undisguised innocence wins him over. She returns his feelings and begins to dream of a simple life in harmony and love. Second, his own brother, to whom he is very close, stands in the way of his ultimate dream: building a hydro-power plant. These two events drive him to pursue his goals with even greater intensity. Surrounded by his friends, he jumps from one business deal to the next, intoxicated by his success. He begins to believe he can have everything. And when his friends suggest how to achieve it, Kamen is faced with a choice that will truly predetermine his life.
